examples.claim: default http://localhost:8000; one model at a time; no native Windows

arXiv 2309.06180 §1: 'Approximately 65% of the memory is allocated for the model weights ... Close to 30% ... dynamic states'

examples.claim: 7-token prompt, block size 4: logical 0->physical 7 (#filled 4), 1->1 (#filled 3); second decode allocates physical 3
examples.source: paper §4.3: 'first 4 tokens in logical block 0 and the following 3 tokens in logical block 1 ... allocates a new physical block (physical block 3)'

examples.claim: Alpaca degrades with large blocks; default block size 16
examples.source: paper §7.2: 'In the Alpaca trace, while the block size 16 and 32 work well, larger block sizes significantly degrade ... vLLM sets its default block size as 16'

examples.claim: beam k=4: after iteration all share 0,1,3; 0·1 share 6, 2·3 share 7; frees 2,4,5,8; allocates 9-12
examples.source: paper §4.4: 'frees all physical blocks whose reference counts reach 0 (blocks 2, 4, 5, 8) ... allocates new physical blocks (blocks 9-12) ... all candidates share blocks 0, 1, 3; candidates 0 and 1 share block 6, and candidates 2 and 3 further share block 7'

examples.claim: memory sharing cuts parallel sampling/beam search memory up to 55%, throughput up to 2.2x
examples.source: vLLM blog 2023-06-20: 'cutting their memory usage by up to 55%. This can translate into up to 2.2x improvement in throughput'
